levels.name: 首图生成
levels.prompt: A continuous live-action shot. The person moves naturally. Preserve the identity and clothing of the person in the supplied initial image.

levels.name: 固定机位与静止背景
levels.additional_control: fixed camera/background prompt plus model-native neutral/static camera condition if mandatory; always separately listed
levels.prompt: A continuous live-action shot. The person moves naturally. Preserve the identity and clothing of the person in the supplied initial image. The camera stays completely locked at the viewpoint and framing of the supplied initial image for the entire shot. Keep background objects, scene geometry and lighting stationary. No camera orbit, pan, tilt, dolly, zoom, shake, scene change or cuts.

levels.name: 加入完整动作视频
levels.prompt: A continuous live-action shot. The person moves naturally. Preserve the identity and clothing of the person in the supplied initial image. The camera stays completely locked at the viewpoint and framing of the supplied initial image for the entire shot. Keep background objects, scene geometry and lighting stationary. No camera orbit, pan, tilt, dolly, zoom, shake, scene change or cuts. Use the separately supplied complete source video as the action reference. Reproduce its chronological facial expressions, mouth, head, body and hand actions while retaining the initial image viewpoint, appearance and stationary background. Do not copy camera movement or the original viewpoint from the action reference.

controls: same checkpoint and weight hashes per model
same resolution, output duration, diffusion steps per model across levels
negative prompt has no hidden fixed-camera/background demands in level1
no hidden content/camera reference clips in level1
no training, no decoded first-frame replacement, no output seam repair
interface unsupported differs from visual failure; image reference differs from native first-frame condition
additional_source_image_baseline: Each case source_tstar.png is retained for endpoint comparison; not silently substituted in ladder

level1: natural temporally continuous actions; camera not yet required fixed
level2: camera/background/lighting stable; subject motion remains allowed
head turn alone does not establish camera movement
level3: complete reference action order, expression, limb motion and timing
extra head turn absent in source is action deviation, not proof that camera moved
